name: Requiem: Possessed Grin
description: The ultimate Requiem addon. Possessed mobs get the demonic powers of The Exorcist: levitation (floating flat), telekinesis, telepathy, the head turn, green bile, poltergeist fury, an icy presence, a demon's voice, unholy strength and the spider-walk. Possessed bodies turn pale and veined with glowing white eyes and a malicious grin. The haunting follows you: knocking in the walls, dying lights, rattling furniture. Cleric villagers fight back with holy water and can cast you out. Craft an Ouija board to hold a seance. Possess the Warden, Wither and Ender Dragon with their real attacks, and even passive mobs can fight.
